rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug cung zad med pa'i skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug cing / de dag thabs mkhas pas bsam gtan dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i dbang gis myi skye'o/ /de dag ni phyir 'dod pa'i khams 'dir skyes kyang / rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba'i rigs su skye'o/ /bram ze che zhing mtho ba'i rigs su skye'o/ /khyim bdag che zhing mtho ba'i rigs su skye ste/ de yang srid pa la brkam pa'i phyir ma yin gyis/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir ro/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang bsam gtan dang po la yang snyoms par 'jug /bsam gtan gnyis pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /bsam gtan gsum pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /bsam gtan bzhi pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /byams pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /snying rje la yang snyoms par 'jug /dga' ba la yang snyoms par 'jug /btang snyoms la yang snyoms par 'jug /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /cung zad med pa'i skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /'du shis med 'du shes med min skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug cing / de dag thabs mkhas pas bsam gtan dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i dbang gis myi skye ba yang yod de/ de dag ni rgyal po chen po bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye'o/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye'o/ /mtshe ma'i lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye'o/ /dga' ldan gyi lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye'o/ /'phrul dga'i lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye'o/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam par

skye ste/ de dag na gnas shing / sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyang mnyes par byed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dag /thabs mkhas pas/ bsam gtan dang po la yang snyoms par 'jug /bsam gtan gnyis pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /bsam gtan gsum pa la yang snyoms par 'jug/ bsam gtan bzhi pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /byams pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /snying rje la yang snyoms par 'jug /dga' ba la yang snyoms par 'jug /btang snyoms la yang snyoms par 'jug /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /cung zad med pa'i skye mched la yang snyoms par ('dug,'jug) /'du shes med 'du shes med myin skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug pa yod de/ de dag ni 'di nas shi 'phos nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skye'o/ /de dag de na yang tshangs pa tshangs chen dbang chen po dang ldan pa brgya phrag bcu la dbang sgyur ba de lta bu'i sems can gyi nang na yang mchog dam pa phul du bya bar 'gyur te/ de dag de na 'khod cing gang na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mngon par sangs rgyas shing / chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba bzhugs pa de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du rgyu zhing 'dong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la yang chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i don du gsol ba gdab pa byed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshe gcig gis thogs pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod

pa dag thabs mkhas pas/ bsam gtan dang po la yang snyoms par 'jug /bsam gtan gnyis pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /bsam gtan gsum pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /bsam gtan bzhi pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /byams pa la yang snyoms par 'jug /snying rje la yang snyoms par 'jug /dga' ba la yang snyoms par 'jug /btang snyoms la yang snyoms par 'jug /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /cung zad med pa'i skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched la yang snyoms par 'jug /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi la yang yongs su sgom/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi la yang yongs su sgom/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la yang yongs su sgom/ dbang po lnga la yang yongs su sgom/ stobs lnga la yang yongs su sgom/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la yang yongs su sgom/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la yang yongs su sgom/ stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la yang snyoms par 'jug cing de dag gi dbang gis mi skye ba yang yod de/ de dag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mngon du gyur pa rnams bsnyen bkur cing / de dag tu tshangs pa'i spyod pa spyad de/ dga' ldan gyi lha dang skal ba mnyam par skye'o/ /de dag der tshe'i tshul bzhin du gnas nas/ dbang po mnyam pa dang / dran zhing shes bzhin du lha bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas bskor te/ mdun du byas nas 'dir skye ba bstan te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs dag tu chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba dag kyang yod do// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu

gcig pa/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mngon par shes pa drug thob pa dag 'dod pa'i khams su yang mi skye/ gzugs kyi khams su yang mi skye/ gzugs med pa'i khams su yang mi skye bar/ de dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa byed cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'dong ba dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mngon par shes pa drug thob pa dag /mngon par shes pa drug po de dag gis rnam par rtse zhing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang na theg pa chen po ma gtogs par/ nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'i sgra yang mi grag pa de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'dod pa dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mngon par shes pa drug thob pa dag /mngon par shes pa de dag gis rnam par rtse zhing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang na sems can rnams kyi tshe dpag tu med pa de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'dong ba dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mngon par shes pa drug thob pa dag /'jig rten gyi khams gang na sangs rgyas kyi sgra mi grag pa dang / chos kyi sgra mi grag pa dang / dge 'dun gyi sgra mi grag pa de lta bu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas 'jig rten gyi khams su 'dong zhing / sangs rgyas kyi legs pa rjod/ chos kyi legs pa rjod/ dge 'dun gyi legs pa rjodapas sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra dang / chos kyi sgra dang / dge 'dun gyi sgra des sems dang bar gyur te/ de nas shi 'phos nas gang na sangs rgyas bcom

ldan 'das rnams bzhugs pa de dag tu skye bar 'gyur bar byed pa dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang po sems bskyed phyin cad bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad med pa bzhi dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / mngon par shes pa lnga dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad dag kyang thob nas/ de dag nam yang 'dod pa'i khams su yang mi skye/ gzugs kyi khams su yang mi skye/ gzugs med pa'i khams su yang mi skye zhing / de dag tu yang sems can rnams kyi don byed pa yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod pa dag dang po sems bskyed pa nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa'i skyon med par zhugs nas/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sa 'thob pa yang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang po sems bskyed pa nyid kyis/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya zhing / mngon par sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te/ sems can grangs med tshad med pa'i don byas nas phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba dang / de dag yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas kyang dam pa'i chos bskal pa 'am/ bskal pa'i lhag mar gnas pa dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems

dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang po sems bskyed pa nyid kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnal 'byor la snyoms par 'jug cing / de dag byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma dag dang lhan cig sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams blta ba dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya ba'i don du 'dod pa dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa/ bsam gtan bzhi thob pa/ tshad med pa bzhi thob pa/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi thob pa dag bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag gis/ tshul du mas rnam par rtse zhing / 'di lta ste/ bsam gtan dang po la snyoms par 'jug go /de dag bsam gtan dang po de las langs nas/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la mnyam par gzhog go /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ bsam gtan gnyis pa la snyoms par 'jug go /bsam gtan gnyis pa las langs nas/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la mnyam par gzhog go /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ bsam gtan gsum pa la snyoms par 'jug go /bsam gtan gsum pa las langs nas/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la mnyam par gzhog go /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ bsam gtan bzhi pa la snyoms par 'jug go /bsam gtan bzhi pa las langs nas/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la mnyam par gzhog go /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ nam mkha'i mtha' yas skye mched la snyoms par 'jug go /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las langs nas/ 'gog

pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la mnyam par gzhog go /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la snyoms par 'jug go /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las langs nas/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la mnyam par gzhog go /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ cung zad med pa'i skye mched la snyoms par 'jug go /cung zad med pa'i skye mched las langs nas/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la mnyam par gzhog go /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched la snyoms par 'jug go /'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched las langs nas/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la mnyam par gzhog go /sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa/ thabs mkhas pa dang ldan pa rnams/ bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa 'di dag yang dang yang du rnam par mnan cing snyoms par 'jug pa dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi thob pa/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi thob pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi thob pa/ dbang po lnga thob pa/ stobs lnga thob pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun thob pa/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa thob pa/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi thob pa/ bsam gtan rnams thob pa/ tshad med pa rnams thob pa/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams thob pa/ rnam par thar pa brgyad thob pa/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu thob pa/ stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa thob pa/ mngon par shes pa rnams thob pa/ ting nge 'dzin rnams thob pa/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams thob pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu thob pa/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi thob pa/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi thob pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma

'dres pa bcwo brgyad thob pa dag /rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum po thob kyang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par myi byed/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par mi byed/ phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par mi byed/ dgra bcom pa nyid thob par mi byed/ rang byang chub thob par mi byed kyi/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / thabs mkhas pas yongs su bzung bas/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa sems can rnams la yongs su ston par byed de/ sems can de dag des rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ba dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ba dang / dgra bcom pa nyid thob par 'gyur ba dang / rang byang chub thob par 'gyur bar byed pa dag kyang yod de/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'bras bu thob par bya ba'i ye shes gang yin pa de ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa yin te/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de lta bus de ltar rnam par spyod pa de dag ni/ phyir mi ldog pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gnas shing / dga' ldan gyi gnas yongs su sbyong ba dag kyang yod de/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag ni bskal pa bzang po par shes par bya'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa/ bsam gtan bzhi thob pa/ tshad myed pa bzhi thob pa/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi thob pa/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun thob pa/ mngon par shes pa drug thob ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu thob pa/ myi 'jigs

pa bzhi thob pa/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi thob pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres bcwo brgyad thob pa dag 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi khong du chud par bya ba'i don du spyod kyang bden pa bzhi rtogs par mi byed pa dag kyang yod de/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag ni tshe gcig gis thogs par shes par bya'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod pa dag /'jig rten gyi khams nas 'jig rten gyi khams su 'dong zhing de dag gi sems can rnams byang chub tu yang dag par skul ba byed cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed pa dag kyang yod de/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag ni bskal pa grangs med tshad med pas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gnas shing / sems can rnams kyi don du rtag par brtson te/ nam yang gnod par 'gyur ba'i tshig mi smra/ gnod pa dang ldan pa'i lus kyi las dang / yid kyi las mi byed pa dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gnas shing / sems can rnams kyi don rtag tu brtson pas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'dong zhing sems can rnams kyi ngan song gi lam gsum po rgyun gcod pa dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gnas shing / 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por gyur nas/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa lhur byas te/ sems can rnams kyi bde ba'i yo byad thams cad nye bar sgrub cing / zas 'dod pa rnams la zas dang / skom 'dod pa rnams la skom dang /

bzhon pa 'dod pa rnams la bzhon pa dang / me tog 'dod pa rnams la me tog dang / spos 'dod pa rnams la spos dang / phreng ba 'dod pa rnams la phreng ba dang / byug pa 'dod pa rnams la byug pa dang / mal stan 'dod pa rnams la mal stan dang / gos 'dod pa rnams la gos dang / nor bu 'dod pa rnams la nor bu dang / mu tig 'dod pa rnams la mu tig dang / gser 'dod pa rnams la gser dang / dngul 'dod pa rnams la dngul dang / byi ru 'dod pa rnams la byi ru dang / rgyan 'dod pa rnams la rgyan dang / 'tsho ba 'dod pa rnams la 'tsho ba dang / khyim 'dod pa rnams la khyim gyis yongs su sdud cing 'tsho ba'i yo byad skyon med pa yongs su sgrub pa dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gnas shing / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lhur byas te/ sems can rnams lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sdom pa la rab tu 'god pa dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gnas shing / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa lhur byas te/ sems can rnams khro ba myed pa dang / gnod sems med pa la rab tu 'god pa byed pa dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gnas shing / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lhur byas te/ sems can rnams dge ba'i chos thams cad la mngon par brtson pa la rab tu 'god pa dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gnas shing / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa lhur byas te/ sems can rnams zhi gnas rtse gcig tu bya ba dang / 'dod pa las dben pa la rab tu 'god pa dag kyang yod do/ /dge ba bcu'i

las kyi lam gyi bar la sems can rnams rab tu bkod nas/ tshangs ris kyi lha rnams nas 'og myin gyi lha'i bar du skye zhing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs su bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /shar dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang bsam gtan bzhi bsgrubs nas/ bsam gtan las yongs su nyams te/ bsam gtan dang po'i ro myangs nas/ tshangs ris kyi lha rnams su skye bar 'gyur ba yang yod do/ /de yang bsam gtan bsgrubs nas 'og myin gyi lhar skyes te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs rnams su bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas shi 'phos nas/ gnas gtsang mar skyes te/ gnas gtsang ma'i gnas gcig gam/ gnyis rgal te/ 'og min du skyes nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs su/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya ba yang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gnas shing / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lhur byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku ci 'dra ba de 'dra ba'i lus su mngon par sprul te/ sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can rnams dang / byol song gi skye gnas pa'i sems can rnams dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa'i sems can rnams la ngan song thams cad las yang dag par bzla ba'i phyir chos ston pa dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gnas shing / sangs rgyas kyi sku ci 'dra ba de 'dra ba'i lus su mngon par sprul nas/ shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed

dag tu dong zhing sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / chos nyan cing byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag kyang mthong bar byed cing / de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag gi mtshan ma yongs su bzung ste/ de bas kyang rgya che ba khyad par du 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po yongs su sgrub cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshe gcig gis thogs pa sha stag skye bar byed pa dag kyang yod do/ /lho phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu dong zhing / sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / chos nyan cing byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag kyang mthong bar byed cing / de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag gi mtshan ma yongs su bzung ste/ de bas kyang rgya che ba khyad par du 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po yongs su sgrub cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshe gcig gis thogs pa sha stag skye bar byed pa dag kyang yod do/ nub phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu dong zhing / sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / chos nyan cing byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag kyang mthong bar byed cing / de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag gi mtshan ma yongs su bzung ste/ de bas kyang rgya che ba khyad par du 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po yongs su sgrub cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshe gcig gis thogs pa sha stag skye bar

byed pa dag kyang yod do/ /byang phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gaṅgā'iklung gi bye ma snyed dag tu dong zhing / sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / chos nyan cing byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye bdag kyang mthong bar byed cing / de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag gi mtshan ma yongs su bzung ste/ de bas kyang rgya che ba khyad par du 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po yongs su sgrub cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshe gcig gis thogs pa sha stag skye bar byed pa dag kyang yod do/ /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu dong zhing / sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / chos nyan cing byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag kyang mthong bar byed cing / de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag gi mtshan ma yongs su bzung ste/ de bas kyang rgya che ba khyad par du 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po yongs su sgrub cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshe gcig gis thogs pa sha stag skye bar byed pa dag kyang yod do/ /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu dong zhing / sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / chos nyan cing byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag kyang mthong bar byed cing / de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag gi mtshan ma yongs su bzung ste/ de bas kyang rgya che ba khyad par du 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po yongs su sgrub cing /

sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshe gcig gis thogs pa sha stag skye bar byed pa dag kyang yod do/ /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gaṅgā'iklung gi bye ma snyed dag tu dong zhing / sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / chos nyan cing byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag kyang mthong bar byed cing / de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag gi mtshan ma yongs su bzung ste/ de bas kyang rgya che ba khyad par du 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po yongs su sgrub cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshe gcig gis thogs pa sha stag skye bar byed pa dag kyang yod do/ /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu dong zhing / sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / chos nyan cing byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag kyang mthong bar byed cing / de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag gi mtshan ma yongs su bzung ste/ de bas kyang rgya che ba khyad par du 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po yongs su sgrub cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshe gcig gis thogs pa sha stag skye bar byed pa dag kyang yod do/ /'og gi phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu dong zhing / sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / chos nyan cing byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag mthong bar byed cing / de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag gi mtshan ma yongs su bzung ste/ de bas kyang rgya che ba khyad par du 'phags pa'i

sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po yongs su sgrub cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshe gcig gis thogs pa/ sha stag skye bar byed pa dag kyang yod do/ /steng gi phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu dong zhing / sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / chos nyan cing byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag kyang mthong bar byed cing / de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag gi mtshan ma yongs su bzung ste/ de bas kyang rgya che ba khyad par du 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po yongs su sgrub cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ tshe gcig gis thogs pa sha stag skye bar byed cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs su/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya ba dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang bsam gtan dang / gzugs myed pa'i ro rmyongs nas tshangs ris nas/ dge rgyas kyi bar gyi lha rnams su skye bar 'gyur ba dag kyang yod do/ /de nas nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched nas/ srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa thob par gyur pa de/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched nas/ srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du skye bar 'gyur ba dag kyang yod do/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di ltar yang / byang chub sems dpa'

sems dpa' chen po/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod pa'i tshe/ mi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan par byas te/ dbang po gsal zhing lus yongs su dag pa dang / ldan par gyur nas/ de dag lus yongs su dag pa de dag gis skye bo mang po'i dga' ba dang / mos pa skyed de/ de dag 'gro ba mang po'i snying du sdug cing yid du 'ong ba dang / sems can de dag kyang sems mos par gyur pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de nyid kyis/ mthar kyis theg pa gsum gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar byed pa dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ lus yongs su dag pa la bslab par bya'o/ /ngag yongs su dag pa la bslab par bya'o/ /yid yongs su dag pa la bslab par bya'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod pa de dag dbang po shin tu gsal ba thob nas/ de dag dbang po shin tu gsal ba de dag gis/ bdag mi stod cing / gzhan mi smod pa dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang po sems bskyed phyin cad/ sbyin pa'i pha rold tu phyi nad pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rold tu phyin dpal gnas shing / phyir mi ldog pa'i sa ma thob kyi bar du nam yang dbul bar mi 'gyur zhing / log par mi 'gro ba dang / ngan song du mi ltung ba dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di ltar yang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ dang po sems bskyed phyin cad/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sa ma thob kyi bar du nam yang dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam mi gtong ba

dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di ltar yang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyind pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por gyur nas/ de dag dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rnams la sems can rab tu 'god pa dang / sbyin pa dang / ngag snyan pas sems can yongs su sdud pa dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sbyin pa'i pha rold tu phyind pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid yongs su bzung ste/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid brgya stong du ma la gnas shing / de dag la gnas nas/ sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma mnyes par byed de/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la yo byad thams cad dang / mchod pa sna tshogs kyis rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa byed pa dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gnas shing / sems can log par lta ba'i mun pa can rnams la/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyis snang bar byed pa dang / bdag nyid kyang nam bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du/ sangs rgyas kyi chos snang ba de dang / nam yang 'bral bar mi byed pa dag kyang yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang sangs rgyas mi bzhugs shing / nyan thos rnams kyang myed pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su rang byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /de thabs mkhas pas srog chags brgya

stong bye ba phrag mang po theg pa gsum gyis yongs su smin par byas nas/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas kyi chos la yang dag par byung ba yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu de lta bas na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa'i lus dang / ngag dang / yid kyi las rnams kyi go mi dbye'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bus/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lus kyi las kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa gang lags/ ngag gi las kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa gang lags/ yid kyi las kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di snyam du sems shing / 'di ni lus yin gyis/ des ni lus kyi las shig brtsam/ 'di ni ngag yin gyis/ des ni ngag gi las shig brtsam/ 'di ni yid yin gyis/ des ni yid kyi las shig brtsam snyam na/ de ni sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lus dang / ngag dang / yid kyi las rtsom pa kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pas ni/ lus gang dang / ngag gang dang / yid gang gis 'jungs pa'i sems bskyed pa 'am/ tshul khrims ngan pa'i sems bskyed pa 'am/ gnod

sems kyi sems bskyed pa 'am/ le lo'i sems bskyed pa 'am/ 'khrug pa'i sems bskyed pa' ma/ shes rab 'chal pa'i sems bskyed par bya ba de lta bu'i lus myi dmigs so/ /ngag myi dmigs so/ /sems myi dmigs so/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ lus kyi gnas ngan len skyed pa dang / ngag gi gnas ngan len skyed pa dang / yid kyi gnas ngan len skyed pa tsam du ni shes par mi bya ste/ de ni gnas myed pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ni 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ lus kyi gnas ngan len yongs su sbyong ngo / /ngag gi gnas ngan len yongs su sbyong ngo / /yid kyi gnas ngan len yongs su sbyong ste/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi lus kyi las kha na ma tho ba myed pa'o/ /ngag gi las kha na ma tho ba myed pa'o/ /yid kyi las kha na ma tho ba myed pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po / lus kyi gnas ngan len sbyong ba lags/ ngag gi gnas ngan len sbyong ba lags/ yid kyi gnas ngan len sbyong ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lus myi dmigs/ ngag myi dmigs/ sems myi dmigs na/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu de'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ lus kyi gnas ngan len yongs su sbyong ba yin/ ngag gi gnas ngan len yongs

su sbyong ba yin/ yid kyi gnas ngan len yongs su sbyong ba yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ sems dang po bskyed phyin cad dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rnams yang dag par blangs te gnas shing / nyan thos kyi sems sam/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sems bskyed pa med par de rtag tu rgyun mi chad par sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po'i sems nye bar gzhog na/ de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lus kyi gnas ngan len dang / ngag gi gnas ngan len dang / yid kyi gnas ngan len yongs su dag pa zhes ngas bshad do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa/ byang chub kyi lam yongs su sbyong zhing / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dag kyang yod do/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i byang chub kyi lam gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ nam lus la dmigs pa med pa dang / ngag la dmigs pa med pa dang / yid la dmigs pa med pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la dmigs pa med pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la dmigs pa med pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la dmigs pa med pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la dmigs pa med pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la dmigs pa med pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la dmigs pa med pa dang / nyan

thos kyi theg pa la dmyigs pa med pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la dmigs pa myed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la dmyigs pa med pa dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la dmyigs pa med par gyur pa de ni/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i byang chub kyi lam yin te/ 'di ltar chos thams cad la dmyigs pa myed cing blang ba myed pa dang / dor ba myed pa'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lam de lta bus pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod cing nan tan du byed pa de dag ni sus kyang thub pa med do/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul ji lta bur spyod pa'i rnams thub pa ma mchis pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gzugs la rlom sems myed pa dang / tshor ba la rlom sems myed pa dang / 'du shes la rlom sems med pa dang / 'du byed la rlom sems med pa dang / rnam par shes pa la rlom sems med pa dang / myig dang gzugs la rlom sems myed pa dang / rna ba dang sgra la rlom sems myed pa dang / sna dang dril rlom sems med pa dang / lce dang rol rlom sems med pa dang / lus dang reg la rlom sems med pa dang / yid dang chos la rlom sems med pa dang / sa'i khams la rlom sems med pa dang / chu'i khams la rlom sems myed pa dang / mye'i khams la rlom sems med pa dang / rlung gi khams la rlom sems med pa dang / nam mkha'i khams la rlom sems med pa dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams la rlom sems med pa dang / mig gi khams la rlom sems med pa dang / gzugs kyi khams la rlom sems med pa dang / mig gi rnam par shes pa'i khams la rlom sems med pa dang /

rna ba'i khams la rlom sems med pa dang / sgra'i khams la rlom sems med pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i khams la rlom sems med pa dang / sna'i khams la rlom sems med pa dang / dri'i khams la rlom sems med pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa'i khams la rlom sems med pa dang / lce'i khams la rlom sems med pa dang / ro'i khams la rlom sems med pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa'i khams la rlom sems med pa dang / lus kyi khams la rlom sems med pa dang / reg bya'i khams la rlom sems med pa dang / /lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams la rlom sems med pa dang / yid kyi khams la rlom sems med pa dang / chos kyi khams la rlom sems myed pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams la rlom sems med pa dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la rlom sems med pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la rlom sems med pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rlom sems med pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la rlom sems med pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rlom sems med pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rlom sems med pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rlom sems med pa dang / nang stong pa nyid la rlom sems med pa dang / phyi stong pa nyid la rlom sems med pa dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid la rlom sems med pa dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la rlom sems med pa dang / chen po stong pa nyid la rlom sems med pa dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid la rlom sems med pa dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid la rlom sems med pa dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la rlom sems med pa dang / mtha' yas 'das pa stong pa nyid la rlom sems med pa dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid la rlom sems med pa dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid la rlom sems myed pa dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid la rlom

sems myed pa dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid la rlom sems med pa dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la rlom sems myed pa dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la rlom sems med pa dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid la rlom sems med pa dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la rlom sems med pa dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la rlom sems med pa dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi la rlom sems med pa dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi la rlom sems myed pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la rlom sems med pa dang / dbang po lnga la rlom sems med pa dang / stobs lnga la rlom sems med pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la rlom sems med pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la rlom sems med pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi la rlom sems med pa dang / bsam gtan bzhi la rlom sems med pa dang / tshad med pa bzhi la rlom sems med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi la rlom sems med pa dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad la rlom sems med pa dang / mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la rlom sems med pa dang / stong pa nyid la rlom sems myed pa dang / mtshan ma med pa la rlom sems med pa dang / smon pa med pa la rlom sems myed pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams la rlom sems med pa dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams la rlom sems med pa dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams la rlom sems myed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la rlom sems med pa dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi la rlom sems myed pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la rlom sems myed pa dang / byams pa chen po la rlom sems myed pa dang / snying rje chen po la rlom sems myed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la rlom sems myed pa dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i

'bras bu la rlom sems med pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rlom sems med pa dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rlom sems med pa dang / dgra bcom pa nyid la rlom sems med pa dang / rang byang chub la rlom sems med pa dang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la rlom sems med pa dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la rlom sems med pa dang / 'khor ba la rlom sems med pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa la rlom sems med par gyur pa de'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis rnam par 'phel ba yin te/ sus kyang thub pa med do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gnas te/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes yongs su rdzogs par byed cing / ye shes de dang ldan pas nam yang ngan song rnams su myi skye/ mi dbul zhing phongs pa nyams su myong bar mi 'gyur te/ lus gang dang ldan pas lha dang / myi dang / lha ma yin du bcas pa'i nang na smad par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i lus yongs su 'dzin par mi 'gyur ba dag kyang yod do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bus/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de lta bu'i ye shes dang ldan pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam yang ngan song rnams su skye bar mi 'gyur ba dang / mi dbul zhing phongs pa nyams su myong bar mi 'gyur ba dang / lus gang dang ldan pas/ lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin gyi nang na smad par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i lus yongs su 'dzin par mi 'gyur ba'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes de gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ye shes de lta bu dang ldan pas ni/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams

gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang mthong ngo / /chos kyang nyan to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye bdag kyang mthong ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ye shes de lta bu dang ldan pas ni/ lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang mthong ngo / /chos kyang nyan to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag kyang mthong ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ye shes de lta bu dang ldan pas ni/ nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅg+gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang mthong ngo / /chos kyang nyan to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag kyang mthong ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ye shes de lta bu dang ldan pas ni/ byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang mthong ngo / /chos kyang nyan to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag kyang mthong ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ye shes de lta bu dang ldan pas ni/ byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang mthong ngo / /

chos kyang nyan to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag kyang mthong ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ye shes de lta bu dang ldan pas ni/ shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang mthong ngo / /chos kyang nyan to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag kyang mthong ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ye shes de lta bu dang ldan pas ni/ lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang mthong ngo / /chos kyang nyan to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag kyang mthong ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ye shes de lta bu dang ldan pas ni/ nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang mthong ngo / /chos kyang nyan to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag kyang mthong ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ye shes de lta bu dang ldan pas ni/ 'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang mthong ngo / /chos kyang nyan to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag kyang mthong ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ye

shes de lta bu dang ldan pas ni/ steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyang mthong ngo / /chos kyang nyan to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba dag kyang mthong ngo / /ye shes de lta bu dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes mi skyed do/ /chos kyi 'du shes mi skyed do/ /dge 'dun gyi 'du shes mi skyed do/ /nyan thos kyi 'du shes mi skyed do/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes mi skyed do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'du shes mi skyed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes mi skyed do/ /bdag gi 'du shes mi skyed do/ /gzhan gyi 'du shes mi skyed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi 'du shes mi skyed do/ /ye shes de lta bu dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod de/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mi dmigs so/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod de/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myi dmyigs so/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod de/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myi dmyigs so/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod de/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod de/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa myi dmyigs so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mi dmyigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid sgom ste/ nang stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /phyi stong pa nyid sgom ste/ phyi stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ phyi nang stong pa nyid sgom ste/ phyi nang stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid sgom ste/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /chen po stong pa nyid sgom ste/

chen po stong pa nyid mi dmyigs so/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid sgom ste/ don dam pa stong pa nyid mi dmigs so/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid sgom ste/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid mi dmigs so/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid sgom ste/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid mi dmyigs so/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid sgom ste/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid mi dmigs so/ /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid sgom ste/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid mi dmigs so/ /dor ba med pa stong pa nyid sgom ste/ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid sgom ste/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid sgom ste/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid sgom ste/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid mi dmyigs so/ /mi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid sgom ste/ mi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid mi dmyigs so/ /dngos po med pa stong pa nyid sgom ste/ dngos po med pa stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid sgom ste/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid sgom ste/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mi dmigs so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi sgom ste/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams mi dmigs so/ /yang dag par spong ba bzhi sgom ste/ yang dag par spong ba rnams mi dmigs so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi sgom ste/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams myi dmyigs so/ /dbang po lnga sgom ste/ dbang po rnams mi dmyigs so/ /stobs lnga sgom ste/ stobs rnams mi dmyigs so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun sgom ste/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams mi dmigs so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa sgom ste/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa mi dmigs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams sgom ste/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams

mi dmigs so/ /bsam gtan rnams sgom ste/ bsam gtan rnams mi dmigs so/ /tshad med pa rnams sgom ste/ tshad med pa rnams mi dmigs so/ /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi sgom ste/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams mi dmigs so/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad sgom ste/ rnam par thar pa rnams mi dmigs so/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu sgom ste/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams mi dmigs so/ /stong pa nyid sgom ste/ stong pa nyid mi dmyigs so/ /mtshan ma med pa sgom ste/ mtshan ma med pa mi dmyigs so/ /smon pa med pa sgom ste/ smon pa med pa mi dmyigs so/ /mngon par shes pa rnams sgom ste/ mngon par shes pa rnams mi dmyigs so/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams sgom ste/ ting nge 'dzin rnams mi dmyigs so/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams sgom ste/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams mi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu sgom ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams mi dmigs so/ /mi 'jigs pa bzhi sgom ste/ mi 'jigs pa rnams mi dmigs so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi sgom ste/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams mi dmigs so/ /byams pa chen po sgom ste/ byams pa chen po mi dmigs so/ /snying rje chen po sgom ste/ snying rje chen po mi dmigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad sgom ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad mi dmyigs so/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu sgom ste/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mi dmigs so/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu sgom ste/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myi dmyigs so/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu sgom ste/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mi dmigs so/ /dgra bcom pa nyid sgom ste/ dgra bcom pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /

rang byang chub sgom ste/ rang byang chub mi dmigs so/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid sgom ste/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid mi dmyigs so/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid sgom ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid mi dmigs so/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ye shes te/ ye shes de dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyang yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ngo / /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ mig lnga rab tu 'thob pa dang / yongs su sbyong ba yod de/ lnga gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sha'i mig dang / lha'i mig dang / shes rab kyi mig dang / chos kyi mig dang / sangs rgyas kyi mig go /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sha'i mig yongs su dag pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sha'i mig gis dpag tshad brgya mthong ba yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sha'i mig gis dpag tshad nyis brgya mthong ba yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sha'i mig gis dpag tshad sum brgya mthong ba yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sha'i mig gis dpag tshad bzhi brgya mthong ba yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sha'i mig gis dpag tshad lnga brgya mthong ba yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sha'i mig gis dpag tshad drug brgya mthong ba yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa'

sems dpa' chen po'i sha'i mig gis dpag tshad bdun brgya mthong ba yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sha'i mig gis dpag tshad brgyad brgya mthong ba yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sha'i mig gis dpag tshad dgu brgya mthong ba yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sha'i mig gis dpag tshad stong mthong ba yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sha'i mig gis 'dzam+bu'i gling mthong ba yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sha'i mig gis gling gnyis mthong ba yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sha'i mig gis gling gsum mthong ba yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sha'i mig gis gling chen po bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams mthong ba yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sha'i mig gis stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams mthong ba yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sha'i mig gis stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams mthong ba yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sha'i mig gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams mthong ba yod do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sha'i mig yongs su dag pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig yongs su dag pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu rgyal po chen po bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha

rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /mtshe ma'i lha rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /dga' ldan gyi lha rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /'phrul dga'i lha rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /tshangs chen gyi lha rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /snang ba'i lha rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /chung snang gi lha rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /tshad med snang ba'i lha rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /kun snang dang ba'i lha rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /dge ba'i lha rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /chung dge'i lha rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /tshad med dge ba'i lha nams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /dge rgyas kyi lha rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /che ba'i lha rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /

chung che'i lha rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /tshad med che ba'i lha rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /mi che ba'i lha rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /mi gdung ba'i lha rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /shin tu mthong ba'i lha rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /gya nom snang ba'i lha rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /'og min gyi lha rnams kyi lha'i mig gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes so/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni/ rgyal po chen po bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyis mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams kyis mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni mtshe ma'i lha rnams kyis mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni/ dga' ldan gyi lha rnams kyis mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni 'phrul dga'i lha rnams kyis mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams kyis mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni tshangs ris kyi lha rnams kyis mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha rnams kyis mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems

dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni/ tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lha rnams kyis mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni tshangs chen gyi lha rnams kyis mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni snang ba'i lha rnams kyis mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni chung snang gi lha rnams kyis mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni tshad med snang ba'i lha rnams kyis mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni kun snang dang ba'i lha rnams kyis mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni dge ba'i lha rnams kyis mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni chung dge'i lha rnams kyis mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni tshad med dge ba'i lha rnams kyis mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni dge rgyas kyi lha rnams kyis mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni/ che ba'i lha rnams kyis mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni chung che'i lha rnams kyis mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni tshad med che ba'i lha rnams kyis mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni 'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams kyis mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni mi che ba'i lha rnams kyis mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni/ myi gdung ba'i lha rnams kyis mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni shin tu mthong ba'i lha rnams

kyis mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni gya nom snang ba'i lha rnams kyis myi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig de ni 'og min gyi lha rnams kyis mi shes te/ lha'i mig de lta bu dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can rnams kyi 'chi 'pho dang skye ba rab tu shes so/ /lha'i mig de lta bu dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can rnams kyi 'chi 'pho dang skye ba rab tu shes so/ /lha'i mig de lta bu dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can rnams kyi 'chi 'pho dang skye ba rab tu shes so/ /lha'i mig de lta bu dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i k+l+lung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can rnams kyi 'chi 'pho dang skye ba rab tu shes so/ /lha'i mig de lta bu dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can rnams kyi 'chi 'pho dang skye ba rab tu shes so/ /lha'i mig de lta bu dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'iklung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can rnams kyi 'chi 'pho dang skye ba rab tu shis so/ /lha'i mig de lta bu dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can rnams kyi 'chi 'pho dang skye ba rab tu shes so/ /

lha'i mig de lta bu dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can rnams kyi 'chi 'pho dang skye ba rab tu shes so/ /lha'i mig de lta bu dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ 'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can rnams kyi 'chi 'pho dang skye ba rab tu shes so/ lha'i mig de lta bu dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'iklung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can rnams kyi 'chi 'pho dang skye ba rab tu shes so/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lha'i mig yongs su dag pa'o// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu gnyis pa/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i shes rab kyi mig yongs su dag pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi myig gang dang ldan pas 'dus byas sam/ 'dus ma byas sam/ dge ba 'am/ myi dge ba'am/ kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa 'am/ kha na ma tho ba med pa 'am/ kun nas nyon mongs pa 'am/ kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa'am/ 'jig rten pa'am/ 'jig rten las 'das pa 'am/ zag pa dang bcas pa 'am/ zag pa med pa'i chos gang yang mi shes pa med pa dang / shes rab kyi mig gang dang ldan pas/ chos gang yang ma mthong ba med/ ma thos pa med/ ma bsams pa med/ khong du ma chud pa med pa 'di ni/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i shes rab kyi mig yongs su dag pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom

ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i chos kyi mig yongs su dag pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i chos kyi mig gis gang zag 'di ni dad pa'i rjes su 'gro ba/ gang zag 'di ni chos kyi rjes su 'gro ba/ gang zag 'di ni stong pa nyid la gnas pa ste/ gang zag 'di'i dbang po lnga ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid kyis skye bar 'gyur ro/ /dbang po lngas de ma thag pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ma thag pa'i ting nge 'dzin kyis rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba skye bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong bas 'jig tshogs la lta ba dang / the tsom dang tshul khrims dang / brtul zhugs bsnyems pa'i kun tu sbyor ba gsum rab tu spong bar 'gyur te/ gang zag 'di ni rgyun tu zhugs pa zhes bya'o/ /des bsgom pa'i lam rab tu thob nas/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang / ngan sems rab tu srabs par byed de/ gang zag 'di ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'o/ /de lam de nyid de bas kyang shin tu bsgoms nas/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang / gnod sems rab tu spong ba thob par byed de/ gang zag 'di ni phyir mi 'ong ba'o/ /de lam de nyid de bas kyang shin tu bsgoms pas/ gzugs kyi 'dod chags dang / gzugs med pa'i 'dod chags dang / ma rig pa dang / nga rgyal dang / rgod pa rab tu spong ste/ gang zag 'di ni dgra bcom pa'o/ /gang zag 'di ni mtshan ma med pa la gnas pa ste/ gang zag 'di'i dbang po lnga ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo mtshan ma med pas skye bar 'gyur ro/ /dbang po lngas de ma thag pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ma thag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba skye bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong

bas 'jig tshogs la lta ba dang / the tshom dang / tshul khrims dang / brtul zhugs bsnyems pa'i kun tu sbyor ba gsum rab tu spong bar 'gyur te/ gang zag 'di ni rgyun tu zhugs pa zhes bya'o/ /des bsgom pa'i lam rab tu thob nas/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang / ngan sems rab tu srabs par byed de/ gang zag 'di ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'o/ /de lam de nyid de bas kyang shin tu bsgoms nas/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang / gnod sems rab tu spong ba thob par byed de/ gang zag 'di ni phyir mi 'ong ba'o/ /de lam de nyid de bas kyang shin tu bsgoms pas/ gzugs kyi 'dod chags dang / gzugs med pa'i 'dod chags dang / ma rig pa dang / nga rgyal dang / rgod pa rab tu spong ste/ gang zag 'di ni dgra bcom pa'o/ /gang zag 'di ni smon pa med pa la gnas pa ste/ gang zag 'di'i dbang po lnga ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo smon pa med pas skye bar 'gyur ro/ /dbang po lngas de ma thag pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ma thag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba skye bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong bas 'jig tshogs la lta ba dang / the tshom dang / tshul khrims dang / brtul zhugs bsnyems pa'i kun tu sbyor ba gsum rab tu spong bar 'gyur te/ gang zag 'di ni rgyun tu zhugs pa zhes bya'o/ /des bsgom pa'i lam rab tu thob nas/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang / ngan sems rab tu srabs par byed de/ gang zag 'di ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'o/ /de lam de nyid de bas kyang shin tu bsgoms nas/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang / gnod sems rab tu spong ba thob par byed de/ gang zag 'di ni phyir mi 'ong ba'o/ /de lam de nyid de bas kyang shin tu bsgoms pas/ gzugs kyi 'dod chags dang / gzugs med pa'i 'dod chags dang / ma rig pa dang / nga rgyal dang / rgod pa rab tu spong ste/ gang zag 'di ni dgra bcom pa'o/

zhes bya bar rab tu shes te/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i chos kyi mig yongs su dag pa'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos gang ji yang rung ste/ kun 'byung ba'i chos can de thams cad ni 'gog pa'i chos can no zhes bya bar shes pas/ dad pa la stsogs pa dbang po lnga 'thob par 'gyur te/ 'di ni sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i chos kyi mig yongs su dag pa'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i chos kyi mig gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di ni sems dang po bskyed pa ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /de'i rgyus dad pa'i dbang po dang / brtson 'grus kyi dbang po dang ldan te/ thabs mkhas pas ched du bsams te/ lus yongs su 'dzin pa byed do/ /dge ba'i rtsa bas brtan pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di ni rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba'i rigs su skye'o/ /bram ze che zhing mtho ba'i rigs su skye'o/ /khyim bdag che zhing mtho ba'i rigs su skye'o/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha'i nang du skye'o/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i nang du skye'o/ /mtshe ma'i lha'i nang du skye'o/ /dga' ldan gyi lha'i nang du skye'o/ /'phrul dga'i lha'i nang du skye'o/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i nang du skye'o/ /de de dag na gnas shing sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed par 'gyur te/ bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis de dag la rim gro byed par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang

yongs su dag par byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la yang bsnyen bkur byed par 'gyur ro/ /rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa byed par 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos kyi sa 'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yang mi ltung ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas kyi bar tu phyir ldog par mi 'gyur ro zhes bya bar rab tu shes te/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i chos kyi mig yongs su dag pa'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan pa'o/ /'di ni lung ma bstan pa'o/ /'di ni nges pa'o/ /'di ni ma nges pa'o/ /'di ni lung bstan par 'gyur ba'o/ /'di ni lung bstan par mi 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni phyir mi ldog pa ste/ /dbang po thob pa'o/ /'di dag ni phyir mi ldog pa ma yin pa ste/ dbang po ma thob pa'o/ /'di ni mngon par shes pa yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /'di ni mngon par shes pa yongs su ma rdzogs pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di ni mngon par shes pa yongs su rdzogs pas shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu song zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mnyes par byed do/ /rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa byed do/ lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu song zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mnyes par byed do/ /rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa byed do/ /

nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu song zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mnyes par byed do/ /rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa byed do/ /byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu song zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mnyes par byed do/ /rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa byed do/ /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu song zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mnyes par byed do/ /rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa byed do/ /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu song zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mnyes par byed do/ /rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa byed do/ /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu song zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mnyes par byed do/ /rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa byed do/ /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu song zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mnyes par byed do/ /rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa byed do/ /'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu song zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra

bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mnyes par byed do/ /rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa byed do/ /steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag du song zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mnyes par byed do/ /rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa byed do/ /'dis ni mngon par shes pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /'dis ni mngon par shes pa thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /'di ni bzod pa thob pa'o/ /'di ni bzod pa thob pa ma yin no/ /'di ni dbang po thob pa'o/ /'di ni dbang po thob pa ma yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing ni yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing ni yongs su dag par mi 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di ni smon lam chen po dang ldan pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di ni smon lam chen po dang mi ldan pa'o/ /'dis ni sems can yongs su smin par byas so/ /'dis ni sems can yongs su smin par ma byas so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di la ni phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'di la legs pa brjod pa mdzad do/ /'di la ni legs pa brjod pa mi mdzad do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang nye bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ /'di dag ni nye bar gnas par mi 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di ni byang chub thob nas tshe dpag tu med par 'gyur ro/ 'di'i tshe ni dpag tu yod par 'gyur ro/

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di'i 'od dang dbyangs dang dge slong gi dge 'dun ni tshad med par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni tshad yod par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni ldan par mi 'gyur ro/ /'di ni dka' ba spyod par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni spyod par mi 'gyur ro/ /'di ni srid pa tha ma pa'o/ /'di ni srid pa tha ma pa ma yin no/ /'di ni snying po byang chub la 'dug par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni 'dug par myi 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di dag la ni bdud yod par mi 'gyur ro/ /'di dag la ni bdud yod par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya bar rab tu shes te/ de ltar na sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i chos kyi myig yongs su dag pa yin no/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sangs rgyas kyi mig yongs su dag pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byang chub kyi sems kyi rjes la/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par byed de/ /de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang ldan pa yin/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang ldan pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad dang ldan pa yin/ byams pa chen po dang ldan pa yin/ snying rje chen po dang ldan pa yin/ dga' ba chen po dang ldan pa yin/ btang snyoms chen po dang ldan pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa bsgribs pa med pa dang ldan pa yin/ de ni de'i myig ste/

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po myig de dang ldan pas/ rnam pa thams cad du ma mthong ba 'am/ ma thos pa 'am/ ma shes pa 'am/ khong du ma chud pa gang yang med de/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi myig yongs su dag pa'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po myig lnga yongs su sbyang bar 'dod pa dang / thob par 'dod pas pha rol tu phyin pa drug la brtson par bya'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar pha rol tu phyin pa drug tu dge ba'i chos thams cad ma 'dus pa myed de/ nyan thos kyi chos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi chos dang / byang chub sems dpa'i chos dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad ma 'dus pa med do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu la la zhig yang dag par smra bas/ dge ba'i chos thams cad 'dus zhes brjod pa zhig tu dgos na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par smra bas brdzod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni mig lnga skyed pa'o/ /mig lnga po de dag la bslabs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni mngon par shes pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rab tu 'thob ste/ de rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam pa du ma nyams su myong bar byed do/ /de ni sa chen po 'di yang rab tu g.yo bar byed do/ /gcig tu gyur cing mang por 'gyur ro/ /mang por gyur cing gcig tu 'gyur ro/ /snang ba dang / mi snang ba yang nyams su myong bar byed do/ /rtseg pa las thal ba dang / rab las thal ba dang / ri las thal bar thogs pa med pa'i lus kyis

'gro ste/ dper na nam mkha' la bya ba bzhin no/ /nam mkha' la yang skyil mo krung gis 'gro ste/ dper na 'dab chags bya bzhin no/ /sa la yang gyen du 'byung ba dang / 'og tu 'dzul ba byed de/ dper na chu la bya ba bzhin no/ /chu la yang 'bying ba med par 'gro ste/ dper na sa la bya ba bzhin no/ /du bar 'thul zhing myer 'bar te/ dper na mye'i phung po chen po bzhin no/ /nyi ma dang zla ba 'di dag 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che la 'di ltar mthu che zhing 'di ltar dbang che ba dag kyang lag pas byugs shing tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du lus kyis dbang sgyur te/ rdzu 'phrul des rlom sems su 'gyur ba med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rang bzhin stong pa dang / rang bzhin dben pa dang / rang bzhin ma skyes pa'i phyir des rdzu 'phrul gang gis rlom sems su 'gyur ba'i rdzu 'phrul de lta bu myi dmigs te/ de thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yid la bya ba ma gtogs par rdzu 'phrul lam rdzu 'phrul mngon par bsgrub pa'i bsam pa tsam yang mi skyed do/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam pa mngon du bya ba'i mngon par shes pa'i ye shes mngon par sgrub pa yin no/ de lha'i rna ba'i khams rnam par dag pa myi las 'das pas lha dang myi gnyis ka'i sgra thos te/ lha'i rna ba'i khams des bdag ni sgra nyan ces bya bar rlom sems su 'gyur ba med do/ /de ni 'di ltar des rang bzhin stong pa dang / rang bzhin dben pa dang / rang bzhin ma skyes pa'i phyir/ rna ba dang sgrar dmyigs pa myed do/ de thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yid la bya ba ma gtogs par lha'i rna ba'i khams la bsam pa tsam yang myi skyed do/ /de ltar na sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ lha'i rna ba'i khams mngon du bya ba'i mngon par

shes pa'i ye shes mngon par sgrub pa yin no/ /des sems can pha rol dang / gang zag pha rol gyi sems sems kyis yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /'dod chags dang ldan pa'i sems la 'dod chags dang ldan pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /'dod chags dang bral ba'i sems la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /zhe sdang dang ldan pa'i sems la zhe sdang dang ldan pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /zhe sdang dang bral ba'i sems la zhe sdang dang bral ba'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /gti mug dang ldan pa'i sems la gti mug dang ldan pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /gti mug dang bral ba'i sems la gti mug dang bral ba'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /sred pa dang ldan pa'i sems la sred pa dang ldan pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /sred pa dang bral ba'i sems la sred pa dang bral ba'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /nye bar len pa dang bcas pa'i sems la nye bar len pa dang bcas pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /nye bar len pa myed pa'i sems la nye bar len pa med pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /kun nas 'dus pa'i sems la kun nas 'dus pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /rnam par 'phros pa'i sems la rnam par 'phros pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /rgya chung ba'i sems la rgyu chung ba'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /rgya che ba'i sems

la rgya che ba'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /yangs pa'i sems la yangs pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /che bar gyur pa'i sems la che bar gyur pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /tshad med pa'i sems la tshad med pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i sems la mnyam par bzhag pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems la mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /rnam par grol ba'i sems la rnam par grol ba'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /rnam par ma grol ba'i sems la rnam par ma grol ba'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /zag pa dang bcas pa'i sems la zag pa dang bcas pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /zag pa med pa'i sems la zag pa med pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa'i sems la nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /nyon mongs pa med pa'i sems la nyon mongs pa med pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /bla na yod pa'i sems la bla na yod pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /bla na med pa'i sems la bla na med pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes te/ gzhan gyi sems shes pa des rlom sems su 'gyur ba'ang med do/ /de ni 'di ltar sems de nyid bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i phyir te/ de ni bdag gis shes so zhes bya
